source_read: https://www.drakeandmorgan.co.uk/<bar>/menus/ for all 17 bars (118 menu calls, fetched fresh 2026-10-08 via the script's --fetch; byte-for-byte the same data/source output as the committed files), re-read with an independent html.parser reader and a Chromium render of The Fable (All Day 64 dishes, Children's 21, identical to the parsed JSON)
notes: Every one of the 89 previously published dishes was checked against all 1,408 of its menu occurrences (calories printed vs data-calories vs ours, Contains/May Contain tooltips, cereal and nut names, the page's own data-allergen-filters vs its tooltips, vegetarian marks): 0 differences; the 44 earlier hold-backs were re-confirmed (26 differing calories, 9 differing labels, 2 over-2,000-kcal, 3 multi-price, 4 contradictions). Description-vs-label keyword scan added 3 hold-backs: Hot smoked salmon & kimchi salad (description names sesame, no sesame mark), Roasted salmon (beetroot aioli, no egg mark, while Chicken Milanese's aioli is marked eggs), Fable mushroom burger (burger, no gluten mark, no bun/gluten-friendly wording). Kept: Seared steak bites (chipa bread: eggs+milk marked, no wheat; chipa is cassava-starch bread), Caesar salad (gluten-friendly croutons), vegan-cheese and vegan-mayo dishes. Page oddity left unpublished: Three cheese truffle mac & cheese prints '262' as its description and no calories. The page itself, not the PDFs, carries calories/allergens (the PDFs print dietary marks only).
